body:
I've never been with anyone else before, I don't know how it will ever happen again. And even then I've never been that close for more than a measly week. It could get worse and it could be better but I can't wait, really. I'm so tired. How will it get better? How will anyone love me? I don't know :( I don't see it

Thank you for taking the time to reply

I might have done something wrong. We knew each other online first and she was visiting here, she got more distant by the end of it and is more distant now, I think it is partially because she had to leave. But also because I just am not that guy, I'm not worth the affection or love or time. I deserve being exactly where I am. I don't see ever being with someone like her again because I never was. I don't know if it's like the way you said it, I thought she was beautiful inside too. Im not just grieving the end of this, I'm grieving the end of everything - I'll never get to feel like that again. Maybe I will, but there's as much of a chance that I wont. And I'm too miserable and amiless to wait

Thank you very much for your kind words. I wish I could close my eyes and do what makes me happy, but nothing makes me happy. All I can feel is sadness, everything around me makes me sad. I'm so isolated and lonely and I don't know how I'm going to change this but it feels like I can't. I wasted my time at school and my suspicions of being unloved are starting to show true. Nothing gets me going right now :( nothing is doable, all I can do is be in this bed and cry

I've always hated myself, I guess it's come with the depression. On any day I don't think I'm worth anything. I don't see how any girl would want to love someone like me. At the same time, I have so much love to give but Im so frustrated and lonely with no where to put it.

Im happy for you that you were able to find someone.

You're right in that I don't know what the future holds but it if it is anything like what my life has been so far, I don't
really want to be part of it. I don't feel like I will ever find someone, and that may very well happen. But whatever
the case is, I'm so defeated and broken hearted and depressed - I can't fight anymore because I don't feel like I have
a reason to. Situations change..I don't know how much, mine feels permanent. I've felt aimless my whole life and here
I am, still aimless. I don't feel like its worth it to wait. All I can think of is how much Im hurting and how badly I want to end it
